scope: Existing adapted U2NETP and balanced whole-body policy migrated into the actual upload worker; no retraining, solver changes or acceptance-threshold changes.

runtime.loading: Lazy local HTTP assets; no photograph upload.

cohortMigration.scope: Shared application crop policy with cached production controls and actual browser NN fields; no refitting or source-image copies. Actual model loading and UI behavior require separate browser QA.
cohortMigration.fixedCause: Do not treat every old needs_selection status as a true crowded frame; the learned locator independently checks components and full-outline coverage.

checks: Real upload loads local ONNX/WASM and reproduces the audited angel corners
Imported angel solves through the actual Find snit flow with template and paper checks
Missing model preserves editable production corners and mask preview
Closing during model loading terminates the worker; reopening produces no stale result
A genuinely crowded frame still asks the user to select one heart

imageError.reference: Classified input crop before border repair, cleanup or tracing
imageError.method: Forward sampling of both slit families at input resolution

browser.visualReview: Both screenshots inspected. Corners cover the overlap square and the angel survives fitting; minor photographic edge irregularities remain. This is not original cutting-path ground truth.
browser.scope: The following session-load retry correction only affects synchronous injected-loader failures. All production crop modules and assets match the browser build; its targeted test passes.

numericalQualification.policy: No tolerance relaxation or exact raw-output claim. Selected corners and downstream masks were audited separately in the fixed development studies.

limitations: Both cohorts have informed development; they are not untouched holdouts.
Some retained geometric crops explain only part of a heart and remain flagged for review.
Printed paper, reflection and occlusion still cause classification and fitting failures.
Desktop Chromium evidence only; mobile performance is unmeasured.
Full application and inverse checks are in progress; not deployed by this record.
